== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
=== Stellar Data ===
'''Alzirr''' has a solitary primary star.
* It is a turbulent white subgiant named ''[[Alzir (star)|Alzir]]''. It is also known as ''[[Alzir (star)|Xi Geminorum]]''

{{MonostellarSystem
|name           = Alzirr
|primary        = F5 IV  
|PrimaryName    = [[Alzir (star)|Alzirr]]
|PrimaryNotes   = [[Flare Star]].
}}

The Alzirr System orbits a white subgiant in the late stages of expansion into a full giant star. Expansion is accelerating but the time frame is still in the millions of years. However, the primary is prone to flares and matter ejections which disrupted an otherwise promising terraforming project.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
Around 60% of personnel on Alzirr are "contract-citizens". They are given citizenship for a few years to help reinforce a claim to the system as a "territorial anchor" but to most of them Alzirr is more of a workplace than a home.
